name: City of Westminster
type: city; London borough; district with city status; unparished area
text: The City of Westminster () is a London borough with city status in Greater London, England. It is the site of the United Kingdom's Houses of Parliament and much of the British government. It contains a large part of central London, including most of the West End, such as the major shopping areas around Oxford Street, Regent Street, Piccadilly and Bond Street, and the entertainment district of Soho.

depictions.name: City of Westminster
depictions.text: The City of Westminster is one of eight boroughs in London. It is featured in Watch Dogs: Legion.
